map.：独立性、客观公正、专业胜任、保密、持续教育、利益冲突回避、报告规范、收费合规各: : independence, objectivity and fairness, professional competence, confidentiality, continuing education, conflict of interest recusal, report standards and fee compliance are each scored 0-3, maximum 24; scoring 3 on each gives 24, an excellent result.
